name: Cannock Foodbank
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at The Space Community Centre. Open Tue and Fri for distribution. Referral required.

name: Staffordshire County Council Allotments
description: Staffordshire County Council manages sites at Elmore Road
image: and Pye Green. Plots from £25/year. Waiting lists available for most sites.

name: Cannock Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run community garden at the former bowling green. Grows vegetables and soft fruits with harvest shared among volunteers. Open Sundays 10am-2pm.
